cohort: 120 women who gave birth at term with head presentation.
finding: Umbilical cord entanglement increased rates of interventional birth, emergent cesarean delivery, vacuum assisted vaginal delivery, forceps assisted vaginal delivery, amniotic fluid meconium, and fetal distress.
mod_finding: Umbilical cord entanglement was associated with higher rates of interventional births, including emergent cesarean delivery, vacuum-assisted vaginal delivery, and forceps-assisted vaginal delivery.
